title: Closure Counter
description:
Implement a `makeCounter` function that returns an object with `increment`, `decrement`, and `getCount` methods. Each call to `makeCounter` should create an independent counter.

**Example:**
```js
const c = makeCounter();
c.increment(); c.increment();
c.getCount(); // 2
```
ai_context: This tests understanding of closures and factory functions in JavaScript.
